scope: Open3D 0.20.0 and Open3D-ML segmentation APIs, public timber and Scan-to-BIM labeling, and whether a 3D LLM can segment construction wood. No library, weight, or LAS was downloaded.
finding: No suitable public stud checkpoint. S3DIS beam/column and BIMStruct3D column are the nearest vocabulary. They are not a residential frame model.

near_term.pick: Classical Open3D on one IntCDC LAS preview after LAS to PLY conversion: voxel downsample, statistical outlier removal, estimate_normals, detect_planar_patches or repeated segment_plane, cluster_dbscan, get_oriented_bounding_box.
near_term.limits: Cluster ids are geometry, not stud/plate/beam. DaRUS has no class map and does not state that scan Z is gravity.

mid_term.pick: Self-label stud, plate, beam, column, other, then fine-tune Pointcept Point Transformer V3. Keep the Open3D box-and-angle step after the network.
mid_term.do_not_ship: BIMStruct3D weights are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and have no timber class. S3DIS and ScanNet weights are not a stud model.

open3d_classical.returns: One RANSAC plane (a, b, c, d) and inlier indices
open3d_classical.when: Peel the largest surface and repeat on the leftover
open3d_classical.fails: Parallel faces of many members fall in one plane

open3d_classical.returns: Oriented boxes; box Z is the patch normal
open3d_classical.fails: A box per face, not per member

open3d_classical.returns: Integer label per point; -1 is noise
open3d_classical.when: Separate members that do not touch, after large planes are gone
open3d_classical.fails: eps merges neighboring studs or shatters one stud; a joint merges beam and post

open3d_classical.returns: One box from PCA of the convex hull
open3d_classical.when: After a cluster is a single member, for the angle paint in doc 02
open3d_classical.fails: Two touching members produce one diagonal box

absent_from_open3d_pointcloud: PCL-style Euclidean clustering as a separate call

open3d_ml.weights_dated: 2020 and 2021 URLs; no 2025 or 2026 weight in that table
